name: Fat Pack Prepackaged Flower | Permanent Cherries
description: Fat Pack: The Original 4 Gram Eighth – a half gram better. Permanent Marker x Cherry Pie combine to create Permanent Cherries, a balanced hybrid that blends euphoric mental effects with a smooth, calming body high. Its sweet cherry and floral aroma with a herbal finish comes from Myrcene, Linalool, and Caryophyllene. Great for both daytime balance or evening ease, it’s a versatile option.
